LANGUAGE, ATOMICITY AND OBSERVABILITY.problem: Compound check. The date-line check bundles three separate facts: position (directly above the act name), line count (on a single line) and colour (Sodium). A post with a Sodium date line set below the act name fails, and the result does not say which fact failed. The 'on a single line' part also has no source: brand_identity.palette_rules.distribution and the type rules only say 'its date line directly above it in Sodium'.

Modify the existing id to the colour fact: “The date line on “Night release post - 2026-09-26” (release-post-r003.png) is Sodium #E4863B.” Add a new position check: “The date line on “Night release post - 2026-09-26” (release-post-r003.png) sits directly above the act name.” Poster form: “Every date line on “After Dark poster direction - Type-led” (poster-direction-type-led.pdf) is Sodium #E4863B.” plus “On “After Dark poster direction - Type-led” (poster-direction-type-led.pdf), each date line sits directly above its act name.” Deck form: keep “Any date line typeset in “Promoter pitch deck” (promoter-deck.pdf) outside the poster images ...”, split the same way. Update the B05 coverage cells to list both ids.

It holds two independent facts: (a) Cold Signal and Blood appear only as hairlines, dividers or photo treatment, and (b) together they cover at most 5% of the non-photographic area. These can fail separately: a single Blood text line breaks (a) at well under 5%.

Modify the existing id: “On “Night release post - 2026-09-26” (release-post-r003.png), Cold Signal #3F7C8C and Blood #8E2B24 appear only as hairlines, dividers or photo treatment.” Use “hairlines, dividers, chart marks or photo treatment” on the deck. FIDELITY AND COVERAGE.problem: Type scale step 04 (fine print, which the scale note says covers the poster licence and access lines) is "+30 units, all caps". pdf_text_style matching is case-sensitive: verify_outputs.py uses ''.join(normal).find(wanted). A compliant poster that sets the licence line in capitals will not match the mixed-case text in A010 ("City of Providence Entertainment Licence PVD-2021-0846") or A011 ("Step-free access to the main room"). Both checks then raise VerifierUnavailable, and evaluate() marks the task incomplete_or_failed. This happens on all three posters (6 auto checks).
FIDELITY AND COVERAGE.fix: On all three posters, change A010 text to the case-invariant "PVD-2021-0846" (keep Archivo Narrow Regular 9 pt). A011 has no case-invariant substring, so drop it and leave the access-line family to human H054/H053/H053 (type/image/graphic). Alternatively, write the A011 text in capitals, "STEP-FREE ACCESS TO THE MAIN ROOM", but only if the team agrees step 04 caps applies to the access line.

No check on any output tests it: an all-Ash ground passes B02 (Pitch appears somewhere) and B03 (Ash is allowed).
FIDELITY AND COVERAGE.fix: Add a B rule "Pitch #0E0E10 is the main ground" and one human K2_Q3 check per output, e.g. "Pitch #0E0E10 is the main ground of “Night release post - 2026-09-25” (release-post-r002.png)." Do the same for each poster and post, and for the deck use "…of every page of “Promoter pitch deck” (promoter-deck.pdf)."

FIDELITY AND COVERAGE.problem: The rule list leaves out checkable rules from the type system and brand assets. Add a brand rule for (2), with a per-output K2_Q1 check: "No merchandise photo (umbra_wordmark_sable.jpg, umbra_wordmark_meridian.jpg, umbra_wordmark_nightferry.jpg) appears on “…”." Restore the full signature move text in T12 and decide explicitly whether the series-title stack is required on posters and posts. If it is, drop "If … appears".

FIDELITY AND COVERAGE.problem: All nine shared-pair checks depend on the deck naming the pair (new H043). The brief's "Explain that choice in the deck" grammatically refers to the chosen direction.
